simple.summary: כִּמְהָם (Kimhâm) means Kimham , an Israelite First listed occurrence: 2Sam 19 38.

definitions.full: H3643. Kimham כִּמְהָם proper name, masculine 1. attendant of David 2Sam 19:38 ; 19:39 = כִּמְהָן v. 19:41 ; ᵐ5 in all Ξιμααμ , ᵐ5 L Αχιμααμ . 2 in noun, of location כִמְהָם גֵּרוּת Jer 41:17 Qr (Kt כמוהם ), compare גֵּרוּת above כִּמְהָן 2Sam 19:41 , see foregoing. כַּמָּה see מָה . כְּמוֺ see below כְּ p.455 above כמוהם Jer 41:17 Kt, see כִּמְהָם .
